aboutUs.title: Inkunga Yacu Spirit of peace and solidarity?
aboutUs.description: Kuko tuzi ko n'ubwo gahunda nziza ari nziza gusa nk'abantu bayikorera. Niyo mpamvu dutanga inkunga yuzuye, guha imbaraga abaturage, n'ibisubizo birambye bikora ingaruka zirambye mu miryango yoroshye yo mu Rwanda.

programsPage.heroDesc: Guha imbaraga impunzi n'imiryango y'abakira binyuze muri gahunda enye z'ingenzi mu karere k'Ibiyaga Bigari
programsPage.intro: Yashinzwe mu 2019 kandi iyobowe n'impunzi, Spirit of Peace and Solidarity (SPS) ishushanya kandi ishyira mu bikorwa gahunda zisubiza ku buryo butaziguye ibikenewe n'abaturage bahunze kandi bari mu kaga. Twizera ko impunzi si abakiriye gusa — ni abantu bakora impinduka.
programsPage.program1Desc1: Kuri SPS, twizera ko uburezi si uburenganzira bw'abahire gusa — ni uburenganzira bw'ibanze kandi igikoresho gikomeye cyo guhindura. Ku mpunzi no ku bagize umuryango w'abakira, uburyo bwo kubona uburezi bwiza n'amahugurwa y'umwuga ni inzira y'ingenzi y'icyubahiro, kwigenera, n'amahoro arambye.
programsPage.program1Desc2: Binyuze muri gahunda iyi, SPS yiyemeza gutsemba imigenzo yo gutekereza ko abandi bakureba binyuze mu guha abantu — cyane cyane urubyiruko n'abagore — ubumenyi, ubushobozi, n'ikizere bakeneye kugira ngo bagenge ubuzima bwabo. Dutanga amahirwe y'kwiga yuzuye, y'ibikorwa, kandi ahindura ubuzima, asubiza ku bikenewe nyabyo mu miryango yacu.
programsPage.program1Desc3: Gahunda iyi ishingiye ku kwizera ko abantu bahunze si umutwaro ahubwo ni umutungo. Bafashwe neza, impunzi n'urubyiruko rwashyizwe habi barashobora kuba abaremyi, abarimu, n'abayobozi bazashushanya ejo hazaza heza kuri bose.
programsPage.program2Desc1: Twizera ko uburyo bwo kubona ubuvuzi ni uburenganzira bw'ibanze bwa muntu. Ariko, mu turere tunini twateshejwe agaciro — cyane cyane aho impunzi n'abaturage b'icyaro batuye — uburenganzira buno buracyari kure. Gahunda yacu y'Ubuzima na Imibereho Myiza yavutse kubera agahinda ko gusarura ubu butari buhari.
programsPage.program2Desc2: Mu bufatanye n'inzego z'ubutegetsi z'ibanze na Minisiteri y'Ubuzima, SPS icunga ivuriro rya mbere na rya kabiri mu miryango yitorohera. Inshingano yacu ni nkuru kandi igira akamaro mu buzima: kugabanya urupfu rw'uruhinja, kurinda abagore bafite inda, no kugira ngo ntawe apfa kubera ko yerekana ko adashobora kugera ku kigo cy'ubuvuzi mu gihe gikwiye.
programsPage.health_approach1: Gutanga serivisi zisesuye n'abaturage: Duzanira abantu serivisi mu turere twateshejwe agaciro, dusanga impunzi n'imiryango y'abakira bisanzura.
programsPage.health_approach2: Ubufatanye n'inzego z'ubutegetsi: Dukorana hafi n'inzego z'ubutegetsi z'ibanze na Minisiteri y'Ubuzima kugira ngo duhuze n'ingamba z'igihugu ku buzima no kugira ngo ibikorwa bikomeze.
programsPage.health_approach3: Guhatira uburinganire mu buzima: Duha agaciro uburyo bwo kubona ubuvuzi ku bagore batwite, abana, n'indi miryango ibangamiwe igomba gutsinda inzitizi zo kubona ubuvuzi bw'imvano.
programsPage.health_approach4: Serivisi z'inzitizi no z'ubuvuzi: Kuva ku ndigande no kwita ku batwite kugeza ku burezi bw'ubuzima no gucunga indwara zidakira, serivisi zacu ni zuzuye.
programsPage.health_approach5: Kubaka ubushobozi: Duhugura kandi dushyigikira abakozi b'ubuzima b'ibanze kugira ngo tubake sisiteme z'ubuzima zikomeza kandi zidasobanukirwa zishobora gukorera imiryango mu gihe kirekire.
programsPage.health_approach6: Impuhwe mu bikorwa: Buri kintu dukora gishingiye ku ntege nke, gitekereza ku kuvura indwara gusa ahubwo no kugarura icyubahiro n'ibyiringiro.
programsPage.program3Desc1: Guha imbaraga nyabyo bitangira n'ubwisanzure mu bukungu. Mu miryango yahungabanye n'ubuhunyane n'ubukene, ubushobozi bwo kubona inyungu zihamye ni inzira y'icyubahiro, imbaraga, n'amahoro arambye. Gahunda yacu yo Guha Imbaraga mu Bukungu yashushanyiwe gusobanura ubushobozi bw'ubucuruzi bw'impunzi n'abagize umuryango w'abakira — cyane cyane abagore n'urubyiruko.
programsPage.program3Desc2: Duha abitabira ibikoresho, ubumenyi, n'inkunga bikenewe kubaka imibereho y'ubwigenzi. Ntiduha inyigisho gusa — tunyuramo inzira hamwe n'abakiriye bacu kuva ku intangiriro ya mbere y'igitekerezo kugeza ku kigo cy'ubucuruzi gikorwa neza, gishyizeho ku isoko.
programsPage.econ_approach1: Guhuza abantu n'umutungo w'amafaranga, harimo inkunga nto, inguzanyo nto, n'inzira zijya mu matsinda y'igihanamigu y'umuryango.
programsPage.econ_approach2: Gutanga inyigisho z'ubucuruzi no kwiga mu mafaranga, zihurizwa ku ntera y'ibanze, bituma abitabira bashobora guhindura ibitekerezo mu bikorwa by'ubucuruzi bishoboka.
programsPage.econ_approach3: Gutanga ubujyanama n'ubufasha buhoraho, kugira ngo buri munyabucuruzi abone ubujyanama bwite n'inama z'ingamba z'inzira nderera.
programsPage.econ_approach4: Guhuza ibigo n'amasoko, binyuze mu gushyigikira ubudonderi bw'ibicuruzwa, ikimenyetso, n'iterambere rya shena y'agaciro kugira ngo ibicuruzwa bibe bigomba ibitumba ku isoko rikusanyirizwamo.
programsPage.econ_approach5: Guteza imbere amakoperative n'ibigo by'amatsinda, bishishikariza kwigana kuri bagenzi, ishoramari ryasabwanywe, n'uburambe bushingiye ku muryango.
programsPage.program3Vision: Icyerekezo cyacu si gukuraho ubukene gusa — ni gukora urugero rw'abarinzi b'ubucuruzi bizeye kandi bigenga bareka gutekereza ko abandi bakureba kandi bayobora impinduka bavuye imbere.
programsPage.program4Label: KWINJIRANA MU MURYANGO, KUBAKA AMAHORO & UBUFASHA BW'UBUNTU
programsPage.program4Title: Kwinjirana mu Muryango, Kubaka Amahoro na Ubufasha bw'Ubuntu
programsPage.program4Desc1: SPS iteza imbere ubufatanye bw'imibereho binyuze mu biganiro, guhana imico, n'ibikorwa by'amahoro bishingiye ku idini. Kandi dusubiza ku bihe by'ihutirwa by'ubuntu binyuze mu gutanga inkunga y'igihe gito ku miryango yahunze no kuyobora uburenganzira, gusubizanya imiryango, n'ibisubizo birambye.
programsPage.program4Desc2: Yashinzwe kandi iyobowe n'impunzi, SPS iri mu mwanya wihariye wo gukemura inkomoko z'amacakubiri n'ubuhunyane. Tusobanukiwe, binyuze mu biturageho, uburyo amakimbirane, ivangura, n'guciranwa hafi byasenyuye imiryango. Kenshi, urubyiruko rw'abasigajwe akazi n'abashyizwe habi rurashukwa n'abapropaganda b'urugomo no kwangana. Ni yo mpamvu twemera amahoro — si nk'ijambo gusa, ahubwo nk'iyemeza ry'ibikorwa ry'buri munsi.
programsPage.peace_approach1: Ibirori by'umuryango bitera imbere itandukaniro no guteza imbere ubufatanye hagati y'impunzi n'imiryango y'abakira.
programsPage.peace_approach2: Inama z'ibiganiro hagati y'imiryango no hagati y'amadini zisenura ingengabitekerezo zangwa.
programsPage.peace_approach3: Gahunda zo guhana imico zikora amahirwe yo gutura hamwe, kwiga, no gukomeza zizere.
programsPage.peace_approach4: Kuyobora uburenganzira no kurindwa kw'abantu bahunze, harimo gusubizanya imiryango no gusubizwaho.
programsPage.peace_approach5: Kurinda abana batarafashwa n'abantu bakuru n'indi miryango ibangamiwe mu bihe by'ihutirwa.
programsPage.ctaDesc: Inkunga yanyu itera imbere SPS kwagura uruhare rwayo mu karere k'Ibiyaga Bigari no kongera ingaruka zayo ku mpunzi no ku miryango y'abakira.

aboutPage.missionText1: Kuri Spirit of peace and solidarity, turashyira mu bikorwa gahunda zuzuye zirimo kurinda imibereho, ubufasha bwihutirwa, uburezi, ibikorwa bishingiye ku idini, guha imbaraga abagore n'urubyiruko, no kurinda imiryango kugira ngo dufashe imiryango yoroshye n'abaturage.
aboutPage.missionText2: Binyuze mu kazi kacu mu miryango itandukanye, twabonye imirwano ya buri munsi imiryango yoroshye ihura na yo, kandi twiyemeje gukemura izo mbogamizi binyuze muri gahunda z'inkunga zihuriweho kandi zuzuye.
aboutPage.visionText: Umuryango aho imiryango yoroshye igira uburyo bwo kurindwa n'imibereho, ubufasha bwihutirwa, uburezi bwiza, ubuyobozi bw'umwuka, n'amahirwe yo kwigenera kugira ngo iterambere rirambe kandi bigenere.

aboutPage.emergencyDesc: Ibiza, ibibazo, n'ibikenewe byihutirwa mu muryango bisaba igisubizo cyihuse cy'ubuntu
aboutPage.opportunitiesDesc: Kubura uburyo bwo kubona uburezi, amahugurwa y'umwuga, n'amahirwe yo kwigenera mu bukungu
aboutPage.responseText1: Ibi bibazo bisaba ibisubizo byuzuye kandi bihuriweho bikemura ibikenewe byihutirwa n'iterambere rirambye. Uburyo bwacu buhuza ubufasha butaziguye n'ubushobozi bwo kubaka no guha imbaraga.
aboutPage.responseText2: Turashyira mu bikorwa gahunda esheshatu z'ingenzi zikorana kugira ngo dutange inkunga yuzuye: kurinda imibereho, ubufasha bwihutirwa, uburezi, ibikorwa bishingiye ku idini, guha imbaraga abagore n'urubyiruko, na gahunda zo kurinda imiryango.

impactPage.heroDesc: Ibisubizo nyabyo biva hasi — inkuru z'ubuzima buhindutse mu karere k'Ibiyaga Bigari
impactPage.stat4Label: Indirimbo z'amahoro zohererejwe mu karere k'Ibiyaga Bigari
impactPage.storyTitle: Inkomoko ya Spirit of Peace and Solidarity
impactPage.storyHeading: Kuva ku Biturageho kugeza ku Mpinduka Zirambye
impactPage.storyP1: Kuva mu 2015, nyuma y'ukubahiriza Itegeko Nshinga no gusenya ry'ubutegetsi bw'Uburundi, inzego z'ubutegetsi z'Uburundi bahannye zashenywe, abarengera uburenganzira bwa muntu harimo umushinga wacu Melance bafashe uruhare rw'ingenzi mu kuvuga ngo bagaragaze ibikorwa bitagengwa n'amategeko. Nk'ingaruka, bahanwaga cyane kandi bahatirwaga, bahatanwa guhunga.
impactPage.storyP2: Ndetse akayeho nk'impunzi, Melance ntiyigeze aceceka. Mu 2018, akiri mu bitaro adafite inkunga, yasanze abantu benshi boroshye bari mu bihe nk'ibye. Ubu bwonko bwerekanye ukuri kubabwiza: abantu benshi baranyimwaga uburenganzira bwabo bw'ibanze kubera ko batarafashwe, batarengerwa, kandi nta bwubahane.
impactPage.storyP3: Ni mu gihe icyo ni cyo igitekerezo cya Spirit of Peace and Solidarity cyavutse. Nyuma yo gusohokera ku bitaro, Melance yashyize ishingiro ry'umuryango ku buryo bw'amategeko, kandi ibikorwa bya mbere byatangiye mu bitaro nyabyo aho yari umurwayi. Iyi saha yerekanye iyemeza rya SPS ryo guturira hafi n'ababangamiwe cyane no kurengera icyubahiro cy'abantu.
impactPage.impactHealthDesc: Binyuze muri gahunda yacu y'Ubuzima na Imibereho Myiza, SPS icunga ivuriro rya mbere na rya kabiri mu miryango yitorohera, igabanya urupfu rw'uruhinja no kugira ngo ibibangamiye — harimo abagore batwite, abana, n'abakuze — bashobore kubona ubuvuzi badatinya kandi bidakomeye.
impactPage.impactAidDesc: Gahunda yacu y'Ubudendezi bw'Imibereho na Ubufasha bw'Ubuntu isubiza ku bihe by'ihutirwa binyuze mu gutanga inkunga y'igihe gito ku miryango yahunze — ibiryo, aho gutura, no kurinda ihutirwa — mu gihe iyobora uburenganzira, gusubizanya imiryango, n'ibisubizo birambye.
impactPage.impactYouthDesc: Binyuze muri gahunda zacu z'Uburezi na Amahugurwa y'Umwuga na Guha Imbaraga mu Bukungu, urubyiruko 300 n'abagore impunzi basimbuye ubushobozi, batangiye ubucuruzi, kandi bafashe intambwe z'ingenzi mu gushaka kwigenera no kugira ubwisanzure mu bukungu.
impactPage.impactPeace: Indirimbo z'Amahoro ku Karere k'Ibiyaga Bigari
impactPage.impactPeaceDesc: Nk'igice cy'akazi kacu ko kubaka amahoro, SPS yakoze indirimbo 10 z'amahoro nk'ibikoresho by'imico kugira ngo zisarure imipaka, zihanye itandukaniro, kandi ziteze imbere ubufatanye bw'imibereho hagati y'imiryango y'impunzi n'abakira mu karere k'Ibiyaga Bigari.
impactPage.visionText: Umuryango aho uburenganzira bwa muntu bugabanijwe ku buryo buringanye kuri bose, nta wenyine usigarwa, kandi ijwi rya buri wese ryumvikana n'icyubahiro, kurindwa, no gukorwa neza.
impactPage.missionText: Gukomeza ubuvugizi bw'uburenganzira bwa muntu cyane cyane impunzi mu gihe ushushanya kandi ushyira mu bikorwa imishinga irambye ishingiye ku mwitabire w'abaturage no ku biturageho.
impactPage.ctaDesc: Hamwe, turashobora gukora impinduka zirambye ku mpunzi no ku miryango y'abakira mu karere k'Ibiyaga Bigari. Buri ruhare rugira akamaro.
